title: Which rail expansions integrated the megaregion? Coverage, connectivity and cross-city opportunity contributions in the Greater Bay Area, 2017-2024
status: outcome-blind frozen design; D accessibility outcomes sealed

replaces.reason: the land-cohort design failed its frozen independent GAIA year-agreement gate (0.08455 observed versus 0.70 required) before any accessibility outcome was read
replaces.salvage_prohibited: do not lower the land-validation threshold or reinterpret IO annual class transitions as verified urban expansion

interpretation_boundary: estimates describe potential accessibility under a common fixed service standard
project contributions are model-based marginal topology contributions, not causal effects on travel, development, welfare or equity
cross-city opportunity is a spatial integration proxy, not observed cross-city travel

scope.group_weighting: compute city summaries first, then use equal city weights for multi-city summaries

spatial_support.water_gate: JRC GSW v1.4 occurrence>=90%; valid fraction>=0.99; permanent-water fraction<=0.20

opportunities.confirmatory: fixed WorldPop Global2 R2025A 2023 constrained UN-adjusted approximately 1 km population mass
opportunities.destination_unit: native WorldPop pixel assigned to one frozen city; population mass is not split
opportunities.supporting_only: supporting only: GHSL R2023A built volume, epoch 2020

network.denominator: exhaustive official city mother tables independent of OSM availability

pedestrian.source: fixed Geofabrik guangdong-260824 OSM PBF downloaded on 2026-08-26 with embedded replication timestamp 2026-08-24T20:20:50Z
pedestrian.snapshot_role: fixed contemporary pedestrian topology for every rail year
pedestrian.routing_relevance: an origin or destination farther than 1200 m Euclidean from every station in the current geography's frozen union network is structural zero access rather than graph missingness; the 5% snap gates apply to routing-relevant population

network.eligible_rail_rule: same frozen urban metro, light rail, monorail and locally operated non-reserved-AFC intercity rule as r6
network.missing_component_rule: a missing official date, locatable geometry or connected passenger topology fails the affected geography; component deletion and absence imputation are prohibited

accessibility.route_requirement: a valid origin-destination path must traverse at least one passenger rail edge
accessibility.generalized_time: origin walk + first-board expected wait + in-vehicle time + transfer walk and receiving-mode wait + destination walk
accessibility.total: A_i(N)=sum_j population_j * exp(-ln(2)*t_ij(N)/30) over valid rail-mediated paths within 120 minutes
accessibility.cross_city: A_i_out(N) uses only destination pixels assigned to a different inferential city from origin i
accessibility.coverage: origin cell centroid can reach at least one passenger-active station through the frozen pedestrian graph within 15 minutes
accessibility.origin_population_weight: WorldPop 2023 mass assigned to the 500 m cell; report area-weighted results separately

events.package_rule: one official activation or suspension component is one package except components jointly activated as one operationally inseparable through-running service, or same-time pieces of one line whose separate operation was unavailable
events.coincidental_same_date: different routes that merely share an opening date remain separate packages
events.negative_events: temporary or indefinite service suspensions active at year-end are retained as removal packages and may have negative contributions

attribution.annual_value_function: start from the preceding year-end topology and apply any coalition of that year's frozen event packages
attribution.method: Shapley marginal contribution across event packages within each year
attribution.closure: for every cell, year and metric, package contributions must sum to the full-network annual change

metrics.coverage: Shapley contribution to the binary 15-minute rail-coverage indicator

project_table: contribution shares from origins uncovered versus covered at the start of the event year
primary_outputs.project_maps: 500 m cell-level total and cross-city Shapley contribution maps for every event package
primary_outputs.annual_maps: 2017-2024 total opportunity, cross-city opportunity and coverage surfaces
distribution_supporting: local Moran clusters with false-discovery-rate correction
primary_outputs.normalization: raw effective population is primary; percent and per-track-km values are supporting and must not be used for zero-length station-only events

sensitivity.R0: official reference geometry, reference standardized impedance and nearest pedestrian node
sensitivity.R1: OSM rail geometry with identical dates, station sequence and reference standardized impedance
sensitivity.R2: official reference geometry and the frozen conservative standardized impedance
sensitivity.R3: reference model with qualifying second-nearest pedestrian node
required: 500 m versus nested 1 km aggregation agreement

opening_order: synthetic graph and Shapley closure fixtures
freeze all nine-city mother tables, event packages, pedestrian graph, WorldPop assignments, code, configuration and hashes
pass D data and numerical gates
stop_rules: stop the affected geography if any eligible rail component or event action cannot be reconstructed
do not make strong project-ranking claims if sensitivity rank or top-quartile thresholds fail
do not interpret fixed-service topology attribution as observed travel behavior
any rule mutation after D opens demotes D and combined results to exploratory
